description:
Advances from a bustling town to a veritable metropolis, full of the wonders of modern technology. This is the Persian city phase.
The 'Times of War' bonus decreases the batch training time in Stables. Large batches will benefit more than small batches.
In mathematical terms: The training time of one batch gets divided by `batchSize^0.1`.
requirementsTooltip: Requires twenty Village Structures and two Town Structures.
tooltip: Advance to Persian City Phase, unlocking advanced buildings, units, and technologies. Civic Centers gain 25% territory influence radius, +10 population capacity, +10 garrison capacity, +5 attack range, +5 Hack Resistance, +7.5 Pierce Resistance, and +2.5 Crush Resistance, but deal 3% less Pierce damage. Garrisoned units restore Structures an additional 1 capture point per second. Persian Stables gain a further improvement to cavalry batch-training efficiency.
